body.contents: The Wendigo gets stronger with each death
After one death, you get faster and gain night vision.
After two, you get the ability to blind hunters
After three, you get larger and do more damage
After four, you gain the ability to summon skeleton reinforcements
After five, you gain a jump height increase

actions.label: Blind Hunters
actions.tooltip: Blind Hunters around you (only usable after 2 deaths)

actions.label: Reinforcements
actions.tooltip: Summon 2 skeletons with swords at the nearest hunter's location (only usable after 4 deaths)
